review_notes: I read the whole target file and the relevant definitions in SpectralMeasure/Construction.lean (`specProjection`, `specProjection_def`, `specProjection_compl`, `specProjection_apply_domain`) and in ProjValMeasure/Basic.lean (`proj_inter`, `proj_congr`, `proj_compl`). I also checked Mathlib's `mul_apply_eq_comp`, which is already `@[simp]`. The file adds no simp lemmas and has no loop or competing-rule risk. The only simp-interface problem I found is that `specProjection` has no lemma layer of its own. Proofs therefore unfold to `spectralPVM.proj` with `specProjection_def`, which is not simp, and then re-fold by hand. I did not run Lean, so I have not confirmed that the suggested lemma and its use compile. I am also unsure whether the simp-normal form should be a product or an intersection. I deliberately did not recommend `@[simp]` on `specProjection_def`, because unfolding it would expose `spectralPVM` everywhere.

findings.problem: The `specProjection` interface has no rewrite lemmas of its own for intersections or complements. The existing lemma `specProjection_compl` is never used in this file. Each proof therefore does `set P := spectralPVM hA`, unfolds with the non-simp `specProjection_def` (`simp only [specProjection_def, ← hP] at hz`), and finishes with `rw [mul_apply_eq_comp, hz, map_zero]`. The complement step is an eight-line `calc` through `P.proj_congr hcompl.symm ...` and `P.proj_compl`, even though `specProjection_compl` states `specProjection hA Bᶜ hB.compl = id - specProjection hA B hB` directly. This repeats the unfold-and-refold detour in `tendsto_specProjection_inter_of_fix` (`simp only [specProjection_def]`, `symm`, `P.proj_congr`, `P.proj_inter`) and in both theorems. The `← hP` fold-back is a workaround for `set` abbreviating `spectralPVM hA`. The same shape appears in other files, such as `SpectralFormBounds.lean` (`rw [show specProjection hA S hS = (spectralPVM hA).proj S hS from by rw [specProjection_def]`).
findings.proposed_change: 1. Add a `specProjection`-level product lemma next to `specProjection_compl` in Construction.lean: `specProjection hA S hS * specProjection hA T hT = specProjection hA (S ∩ T) (hS.inter hT)`, proved from `(spectralPVM hA).proj_inter`. Optionally add a `specProjection_congr` for set equalities, proved by `subst` as `ProjValMeasure.proj_congr` is. 2. Rewrite the two `*_apply_eq_self_*` lemmas so the complement step reads `rw [← Set.compl_Iio, specProjection_compl hA _ measurableSet_Iio]` followed by `sub_apply`, `id_apply`, `hIio`, `sub_zero`. 3. Derive `hIio` from the new product lemma without `set P` or `← hP`. 4. The inner goal `Set.Iio c ∩ Set.Iic c = Set.Iio c` can use `Set.inter_eq_left.mpr Set.Iio_subset_Iic_self` (both lemmas exist in Mathlib) instead of `ext`/`simp only`/`constructor`. Keep `specProjection_def` non-simp so `spectralPVM` is not exposed everywhere.
findings.benefit: Proofs stay at the `specProjection` level instead of unfolding to `spectralPVM.proj` and folding back. This removes the `set ... with hP` / `← hP` workaround and the hand-written complement `calc`, which is duplicated across the Ici/Iic twins. It also makes the existing `specProjection_compl` the single canonical complement rewrite, and downstream files such as SpectralFormBounds.lean and RayleighRitz.lean can use the same lemmas.
